title: Envelope
description: The fields every stored document carries, whatever its entity. Not a collection's schema itself: each entity's schema refers to these fields one by one.

orgId.description: The ID of the organisation that submitted the request.

revision.description: The document's revision: 1 when it's created and +1 on every write, so it can serve as its ETag.

updatedAt.description: When the document was last written; its createdAt until it's updated.

traceId.description: The trace ID of the request that last wrote the document, for finding it in the logs.

payload.description: The original request body as UTF-8 JSON, stored as sent and never queried or edited. API responses are built from it, and the other fields can be worked out from it again.
